hero.free: Free to join · No credit card required

problem.title: Most career platforms weren't built for you.
problem.description: They assume you already have a CS degree, a network in tech, and time to figure it out alone. Career changers — especially women — deserve something better.
problem.item0body: "Should I learn Python or JavaScript first?" Generic advice leads to months of spinning wheels.
problem.item1body: Stack Overflow is great if you know what to search. Bootcamps end. Communities go quiet.
problem.item2body: Spaces built by and for people who've never had to prove they belong aren't built for you.

features.title: Everything you need to make the switch
features.subtitle: One platform. No juggling ten tabs and hoping for the best.
features.item0desc: A step-by-step roadmap tailored to where you are and where you want to go — frontend, data, DevOps, or product.
features.item1desc: 1:1 sessions with engineers and managers who made the switch themselves. Honest advice, no gatekeeping.
features.item2desc: A space where asking "where do I start?" is always welcome. Study groups and peer accountability.
features.item3desc: Curated opportunities from companies that actively invest in diversity and support career changers.

steps.title: From "where do I start?" to hired.
steps.subtitle: Three steps. One clear path.
steps.step0desc: Answer a few questions about your background and the tech role you're aiming for.
steps.step1desc: Access curated resources, milestones, and mentors matched to your profile.
steps.step2desc: Apply to jobs with confidence — your profile shows your progress, not just your past.
